program_name: Project HarborScale - Port Logistics & Digital Core Transformation

milestones.name: Automated Yard Gate & OCR Recognition Engine

critical_risks.title: EDI Parser Vendor API Rate Limiting
critical_risks.mitigation: Implemented local Redis cache layer and batched micro-queues. Throughput increased by 420%.

critical_risks.title: Harbor Pilot Mobile App Offline Sync Conflict
critical_risks.mitigation: Migrated to CRDT-based deterministic state synchronization with automatic conflict resolution.

key_accomplishments: Successfully cut gate turnaround dwell time from 42 minutes to 16.5 minutes per truck.
Integrated 18 shipping carriers via AS2 / EDIFACT / JSON REST connectors with 99.98% uptime.
Achieved ISO 27001 data security compliance across all ingestion endpoints.
